setup: This is a question about the structure of a quadratic.

steps.say: A quadratic is ax² + bx + c = 0 with a ≠ 0. Here the leading coefficient is 1, so b and c can be read straight off the expression — and b is [[b]].
The quadratic formula gives x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) / 2a, which here is (−b ± √(b² − 4c)) / 2. Its two values are [[r1]] and [[r2]], and the smaller is [[lo]].
The discriminant b² − 4ac is the one number that settles the number and type of roots: above 0 gives two real, exactly 0 gives one, below 0 gives two complex. Here it is [[disc]].
A graph of ax² + bx + c is the shape the leading coefficient stretches, flips or squashes but never unbends — a parabola.
